denominator: 30-day labelled PRs in the fixed merge-time window
rules: Preserve the frozen marker baseline; do not change the feature manifest or training rows.
Only labels whose names explicitly assert generation, authorship or assistance count by default; bare tool names do not.
No repo-specific owner mappings are inferred or invented.
Read body and label state at merge; missing historical evidence remains unavailable.
Generic Bot authorship is counted separately and never establishes agent involvement.
Known harness metadata is observed harness evidence; it is not verified executed-model identity.
Sample within each repo and disjoint stratum by ascending sha256(seed|repo|stratum|PR number).
No rework outcome values are used in sampling beyond the fixed non-null eligibility predicate.
AI evidence review is reported separately from independent human validation; unmarked does not mean human.
